sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 45

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 45:1
items.html: The white hairs between the hairs of the head of Arich Anpin are divided into thirteen white paths between the hairs. And this division is according to the twelve letters of the three HaVaYaHs and the one that includes them all, as in Answer 20 above, see there. (Page 344, Item 109).
